Subject: Re: Post-pilot credit reflow request

Jonas / Laura —

Short answer: both are possible, but they have different downstream controls. 

Options we typically offer:
- Credit memo (CM): We issue a CM referencing INV-7890, customer posts it on their ledger, and we create a contra AR entry. This is clean for audit trails and tax reporting.
- Invoice offset: We apply a negative line item on the next invoice to net the balance. This is operationally simpler for cash collection but can complicate tax reporting if the original invoice was already recognized.

For Orchid (US, non-taxable SaaS in their state), invoice offset is permissible provided we retain a signed customer authorization on file and we include the following metadata: PO number, exact amount to offset, target invoice number (INV-7890), and line-level description. We also need to book the offset to GLA 4702 (Customer Credits — Promotions) and tag the revenue recognition adjustment with REV-ADJ code RWD-POC-2026.

Please confirm:
- Final offset amount (USD)
- PO number on Orchid's side
- Which invoice to net against (INV-7890 confirmed?)

I'll prepare the credit memo draft in case Ops prefers that route (attached: credit_memo_draft.xlsx).

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

Attachments: credit_memo_draft.xlsx (XLSX)

Thanks Marcus — appreciate the clear options. Finance ops decision: proceed with an invoice offset against INV-7890 to keep Orchid's AR tidy and accelerate close. We will require the signed authorization from Orchid (Sara's confirmation is sufficient) and the PO number so our ERP can post the negative line.

Operational instructions for Marcus / Finance Ops:
- Apply negative line item for USD 12,400 on the upcoming invoice (Invoice date 2026-09-17) referencing INV-7890 in the memo field.
- Use GLA 4702 for the offset and tag REV-ADJ as RWD-POC-2026.
- Split the offset into two lines: USD 7,400 (compute credits) and USD 5,000 (support credits) per Orchid's pilot breakdown — helps downstream cost allocation.
- No tax applies; mark Tax Code = NT (non-taxable).

Sara — can you confirm the PO number and confirm that your team approves Redwood applying the offset as described? Once we have that confirmation I'll ask Marcus to schedule the ERP posting and send the customer-facing invoice copy.

Best,
Laura Bennett
